words.title: Pellow Yoga: a yoga studio in Leith, Edinburgh
words.heroLead: Drop-in and weekly yoga classes, Monday to Saturday, from £11.50 a class.
words.regularsLead: This device remembers the class you come to each week, so booking it again is one button.
words.classesLead: Monday 16 to Saturday 21 November, up to 14 mats in each class.
words.classBody: Long holds, simple standing poses and the breath counted out loud. The pace stays even for the whole hour, and every pose has an easier version you can take at any point.
words.confirmTitle: Book a place in a class
words.confirmLead: No account needed. Your place is held as soon as you send the form.
words.confirmSent: Your class is booked. The confirmation email is on its way.
words.bookedBody: Your place is held the moment you book. The confirmation email names the class, the time and the teacher, and there is nothing to print or bring but yourself.
words.cancelLine: Cancel in one tap from your confirmation email
words.decidedLead: Four choices made for this booking page, and where each one came from.
